title: Model Catalog (v2)
description: Envelope returned by GET /api/v2/models (agent) and GET /api/v1/models (gateway pass-through) per SPEC-024 R-2: the credential-gated catalog of selectable models. Discovery-safe by construction — no credentials, no base URLs.

id.description: Selectable model id (the provider name); sent as the chat request 'model' field.

label.description: Display label: the configured model name (e.g. 'deepseek-v4-flash').

default.description: True for the deploy-time active profile's model.
Id of the default model, or null when no model is configured.
